7.Name: Horatio's Staff
7.Description: Alas, poor Horatio. He didn't even like staves...

8.Name: Wrath of Sciurus
8.Description: Crafted with ... oh, you said SQUIRE?

11.Name: Staff of Malachite
11.Description: He wants you, too... oh. Malachite. Never mind.

55.Name: Morning Star
55.Description: It's great for bashing in your enemy's shiny armor. Hmmm... seems the Zardman boss holds another unique mace now.

156.Name: Unarmed
156.Description: Can you say martial arts? Now your HANDS are the deadly weapon!

289.Name: Scarecrow Hat
289.Description: A scarecrow doesn't really need a hat. You'll put it to better use.

393.Name: Deadhead Mallet
393.Description: It's... kind of a cute stone mallet with a carving of a skull on it.

410.Name: Renegade
410.Description: Recommended enhancement: Thief. Rogue base class upgrade!

443.Name: Berserker
443.Description: Recommended Enhancement: Fighter. Mad with rage, a Berserker is a warrior fueled by fury!

476.Name: ProtoSartorium
476.Description: Recommended enhancement: Hybrid. A mechanical marvel! ProtoSartorium utilize heat and steam to enhance their natural abilities and exceptional defenses.

538.Name: Taro's Manslayer
538.Description: Taro had fought over a 1000 battles in his lifetime. ( You can probably relate.) His spirit, experience and discipline are captured in this sword. Use it well...

582.Name: Dragonslayer
582.Description: Recommended enhancement: Fighter. Dragonslayers are specialized warriors specifically trained to hunt dragons and dragonkin.

994.Name: Royal Suit
994.Description: The good sometimes like to dress up for special occasions... like battling the forces of EVIL!

1075.Name: Cardboard Sword
1075.Description: Made from 100% recycled empty toilet paper rolls

1217.Name: Noble Cloak
1217.Description: This cloak has decorative designs along the trim. (color custom)

1238.Name: Sneeviltron
1238.Description: You are now a Mini Sneevil War Machine!

1407.Name: Pactagonal Knight Statue
1407.Description: A stone statue of a Pactagonal Knight. Be wary of the sharp edges!

1446.Name: Eye of Chaos
1446.Description: A chaos eye showing that your house has been chaorrupted!

1463.Name: Pactagonal Knight Statue
1463.Description: A stone statue of a Pactagonal Knight. Be wary of the sharp edges! (faces right)

1576.Name: Black Knight Orb
1576.Description: A dark, glowing orb that allows you to see the Evil spirit of the Black Knight!

1755.Name: Vath's Chaotic Dragonlord Armor
1755.Description: This Dragonlord armor is tainted by chaos! Only those who have slain Lord Vath can wear this.

1770.Name: Undead Warrior
1770.Description: Horrific warrior of the Frozen Legion, this barbaric armor was created by your fellow player, Dage the Evil!

1844.Name: Escherion's Robe
1844.Description: The robes that once clothed the first Lord of Chaos now belong to you! Chaos makes you look slimming.

2083.Name: DoomKnight
2083.Description: Recommended enhancement: Fighter. The Doomknight shows little sympathy for the living. Not even death could stop your destructive rampage. (Requires Rank 5 Evil, Rank 10 Warrior, Rank 10 Healer)

2086.Name: Sepulchure's Helm
2086.Description: Seeing you in your DoomKnight OverLord armor would be enough to send any foe running but when they see Sepulchure's own helm they will run screaming!

4676.Name: Purified Claymore of Destiny
4676.Description: Polish imbues your Warrior Claymore with divine light!

4712.Name: Unidentified 3
4712.Description: Swindle says, It's a "Dragon Bone Hammer". Lucky you!

4715.Name: Unidentified 6
4715.Description: Swindle says, very nice, you won a "Parasitic Hacker".

4718.Name: Unidentified 9
4718.Description: Swindle say, that's an "Ordinary Iron Wing Helm". It's useful as a base for more extravagant helms to be made from though.

4723.Name: Unidentified 10
4723.Description: Swindle starts to laugh hysterically. That my friend is a "Bag of Dirt"! Enjoy! Can stack up to x1000.

4724.Name: Godly Golden Dragon Axe
4724.Description: Nulgath takes your signed contract in exchange for this impressive "Godly Golden Dragon Axe". You're excited yet uneasy, as Nulgath goes on to say, "Enjoy! As it states in the contract you signed, you can owe me later for this."

4748.Name: Unidentified 15
4748.Description: Swindle say, I picked up that "Emblem Mace" during my stay at Sword Haven.

4749.Name: Unidentified 16
4749.Description: Swindle tells you that this is an "Iron Plate Hammer".

4752.Name: Unidentified 19
4752.Description: Swindle says, it's a "Koi Fish in a Sphere". It can follow you around on land while in that nifty little sphere.

4762.Name: Unidentified 13
4762.Description: You've got yourself "The Contract of Nulgath". This item can get you many things, but know that a signature is eternally binding. You wonder what language the contract is written in.

4763.Name: Drudgen the Assistant
4763.Description: (Can't be sold or refunded!) Nulgath says, this little Sneevil can assist you with Swindle's Quests. He'll make your life much easier and will allow you to help others who cannot pass the barriers you can.

4764.Name: Corpse Maker of Nulgath
4764.Description: Nulgath takes your signed contract in exchange for the "Corpse Maker of Nulgath". You're excited yet uneasy, as Nulgath goes on to say, "Enjoy! As it states in the contract you signed, you can owe me later for this."

4766.Name: Ddog Sea Serpent Sword
4766.Description: Nulgath says, Ddog is a powerful hero indeed. He's still growing in strength and will do great things one day. To honor him, he crafted this weapon. Those that own this blade are lucky.

4767.Name: Unidentified 20
4767.Description: Nulgath slayed a dragon and crafted this sword form it's very bones. Congratulations on winning the "Dragonbone Blade"!

4769.Name: Tainted Gem
4769.Description: A gem tainted with void energy. While considerably more valuable than a diamond's, it is still fairly common.

4770.Name: Dark Crystal Shard
4770.Description: A small, refined shard imbued with dark magic. Significantly more valuable than a Tainted Gem.

4771.Name: Diamond of Nulgath
4771.Description: A diamond brought from the void. Despite being a diamond, its value is less than that of the ArchFiend's other gemstones.

4808.Name: Unidentified 21
4808.Description: Nulgath slayed a dragon and crafted this sword form it's very bones. Congratulations on winning the "Dragonbone Axe"!

4809.Name: Oblivion Blade of Nulgath Pet (Rare)
4809.Description: Nulgath empowers your "Sword of Nulgath". You realize Nulgath himself can communicate directly to you, AND ONLY YOU, through this sword. The sword now teems with powerful energy, revealing new secrets. Nulgath will not speak to anyone but you through this blade. (note: sword will only give quest to its owner) (Rare)

4829.Name: Unidentified 28
4829.Description: Swindle says, that dagger is a "Spinal Tap". Nulgath likes these daggers.

4844.Name: Ddog's Sea Serpent Armor
4844.Description: Nulgath says, this armor was forged from the power of the Great Sea Serpent. This armor is a relative of the sword counterpart.

4845.Name: Crag & Bamboozle
4845.Description: (Can't be sold or refunded!) These two assistants work for Nulgath. They each have different quests. Click on them to switch quests. They will not share their quests with anyone but you!

4847.Name: Primal Dread Fang
4847.Description: Nulgath created these daggers from the actual fangs of a great void beast.

4862.Name: Voucher of Nulgath (non-mem)
4862.Description: This is good for certain items Nulgath might have crafted and can also be used for a variety of other purchases from Nulgath. You may only own 1 voucher at a time.

4889.Name: Combat Trophy
4889.Description: A mark signifying honorable player versus player (PvP) combat. It's not about winning, it's about making sure the other person loses.

4937.Name: Claw of Nulgath
4937.Description: Although a basic version, this weapon uses arcane magic to bind itself to it's wearer's hands.

4945.Name: Bard
4945.Description: Recommended enhancement: Healer. Music rocks your world, and the battlefield. Your special abilities allow you to stay in tune with those around you, whether your powers are used to heal or to hurt.

5052.Name: Hex Blade of Nulgath
5052.Description: This sword is bejeweled with powerful gems.

5086.Name: Classic Dragonlord
5086.Description: Recommended enhancement: Fighter. DragonLords are aggressive front-line soldiers. They are skilled in an ancient school of combat from the era of DragonFable. Only those with Dragon Amulets can be a DragonLord.

5223.Name: Megaphone MegaGun
5223.Description: FOR THE TIMES WHEN CAPS LOCK IS NECESSARY!!!

5291.Name: Hollowsoul Castle
5291.Description: Intimidating inside and out! This castle features 4 spacious rooms, is Wraith-free, and you will never have to worry about watering your plants ever again... it rarely stops raining outside.

5357.Name: Totem of Nulgath
5357.Description: A wooden carving with features resembling those of the ArchFiend. The essence contained within is far more valuable than any gemstone.

5484.Name: Basic War Sword
5484.Description: A basic blade that can be used for Good or for Evil; if you are one of the Chosen, you can turn this sword in for the Behemoth Blade!

5518.Name: Undead Champion
5518.Description: Unaffected by emotions and impervious to remorse, Champions pledge their full allegiance to the Undead Legion. Showing mercy is a sign of weakness, and weakness is not tolerated.

5529.Name: Bane of Nulgath
5529.Description: Nulgath infused this blade with the blood of fallen foes.

5584.Name: Sparrow's Blood
5584.Description: This potion grants 50% Evasion, 20% Haste, and a heal-over-time effect when consumed.

5586.Name: Elders' Blood
5586.Description: Greatly heightens combat ability, but damages you over time when consumed.

5590.Name: Scroll of Life Steal
5590.Description: Drains some of the target's HP and gives it to you. (Scrolls must be equipped in order to be used from your Action Bar!)

5832.Name: Mirror Drakath
5832.Description: As the Champion of Order, Drakath in the Mirror Realm stands for everything righteous and good. Only a select few are worthy enough to wear such a prestigious suit of armor.

6136.Name: Gem of Nulgath
6136.Description: A clear gem that radiates with power. It is said these were once used as a catalyst to forge other gemstones, but the method was lost to time. Slightly more valuable than a Dark Crystal Shard.

6139.Name: Fighter Crag & Bamboozle
6139.Description: Equip Necromancer class to have this pet fight for you! "It's smashing time" says Crag.

6140.Name: Oblivion Wrath Blade Of Nulgath
6140.Description: Equip Necromancer class to have this pet fight for you! This blade is for battle only!

6242.Name: Iron Rune Dragon
6242.Description: The Iron Rune Dragon is not actually a baby dragon but a dwarven construct shaped and given life deep within the Great Forge in Dwarfhold Keep.

6425.Name: Chaos Warrior
6425.Description: There are those who are controlled by Chaos and those who control it! You have BECOME Chaos, fighting to further its chaorrupted cause!

6426.Name: Chaos Warrior Masks
6426.Description: You have been too long involved with Chaos. Its twisted, unpredictable forces have mutated you - growing horns and discoloring your face. Not even your own mother would recognize you now.

6533.Name: Nulgath Horns
6533.Description: You sprout fiendish horns from your head as the taint within you grows ever stronger!

6535.Name: Bright Aura
6535.Description: It is believed that when enough Loyal Spirit Orbs gather together, they form a holy Bright Aura. If you can gather enough Bright Auras, then you might be able to forge an item of "Blinding Light."

6537.Name: Brilliant Aura
6537.Description: When a collection of Bright Auras merge together, they form a glorious ambiance known as a Brilliant Aura. If you can gather enough Brilliant Auras, then you might be able to forge an item of "Blinding Light."

6644.Name: Fishing Bait
6644.Description: USE TO RANK UP FISHING TRADESKILL! /join Fishing to use. Everything from earthworms to plankton (for whale catching?). This here bait is specially bread to attract the strangest... I mean the BEST fish in all of Greenguard.

6697.Name: Undead Essence
6697.Description:
A strange mystic soul once belonging to an Undead beast. Collecting enough of these may make it possible to merge them with something else... or you can sell it to make some quick gold!
Can stack up to x1000.

6774.Name: Corrupt Spirit Orb
6774.Description: Some Dark Spirit Orbs are too corrupt to return to the Plane of Darkness. If one collects enough Corrupt Spirit Orbs, then they too will be consumed by the shadows... and in return shall harness unspeakable power...

6979.Name: Polistar's Star Suit
6979.Description: Battle through the stars in a spacesuit fit for a marine... or a maurader!

7189.Name: Matrix Conduit Katana Pet
7189.Description: Energy freely flows through this blade pet, giving more than "static" quality to it. NOT A BATTLE PET.

7190.Name: Dragon's Twilight
7190.Description: This blade is inlaid with age-darkened lapis lazuli and will remind you of warm nights staring up at the sky, waiting for the stars to guide you to your next rendezvous point with the rest of the DragonSlayer Order.

8012.Name: Necromancer
8012.Description: Recommended enhancement: Wizard. Embrace the Darkness that lies within you. Channel it to control the Undead that surround you. The darkest Power can be yours!

8065.Name: 8th Betrayal Blade of Nulgath Pet
8065.Description: Equip Necromancer class to have this pet fight for you! With enough manipulation, anything is possible. The Betrayal Blade now fights for you on it's own!

8066.Name: 7th Betrayal Blade of Nulgath Pet
8066.Description: Equip Necromancer class to have this pet fight for you! With enough manipulation, anything is possible. The Betrayal Blade now fights for you on it's own!

8067.Name: 6th Betrayal Blade of Nulgath Pet
8067.Description: Equip Necromancer class to have this pet fight for you! With enough manipulation, anything is possible. The Betrayal Blade now fights for you on it's own!

8068.Name: 5th Betrayal Blade of Nulgath Pet
8068.Description: Equip Necromancer class to have this pet fight for you! With enough manipulation, anything is possible. The Betrayal Blade now fights for you on it's own!

8441.Name: Dragon Hero Armor
8441.Description: The greatest Heroes of Lore embrace the power, strength, and intelligence of the mighty Dragon race. Channeling the Dragon spirit, they find themselves able to overcome any force that would oppose them!

8446.Name: Dragon Hero's Helm
8446.Description: With horns to symbolize strength and vitality and wings to symbol wisdom and creativity, this helm will protect you both in battle and out of it!

8492.Name: Ominous Aura
8492.Description: It is said that when enough Corrupt Spirit Orbs synthesize together, it creates an atrocious ambiance called the Ominous Aura. If one collects enough Ominous Auras, then they too will be consumed by the shadows... and in return shall harness unspeakable power...

8503.Name: Draconic Fury
8503.Description: Wield this blade well, Warrior! Imbued with the spirit of an ancient draconic sage, this weapon will aid you in battle as you fight the forces which would overtake Lore!

8523.Name: DoomKnight
8523.Description: Recommended enhancement: Fighter. Feared throughout history, the Doomknight shows little sympathy for the living. Not even death could stop your destructive rampage.

8535.Name: Chaos Shaper
8535.Description: Recommended enhancement: Lucky. You have come to understand that Chaos is a tool that can be used for neither good nor evil. Mastering it could make you powerful beyond imagining. Lest you lose yourself...

8555.Name: Chaos Shaper Sword
8555.Description: A weapon with a truly chaotic nature, this sword is capable of dealing out massive damage or very little. You never can tell.

8559.Name: Chaos Shaper Helm
8559.Description: Embracing Chaos is as difficult as anything can possibly be. The mystical design of this helm not only protects your head from unexpected accidents, it also magically holds your mind together.

8560.Name: Chaos Warrior Omegus
8560.Description: With this blade, you will bring about the End: the end of your opponents, the end of Order, and the end of LORE itself! All shall fall to the power of Chaos!

8690.Name: UndeadSlayer
8690.Description: Recommended enhancement: Fighter. Wield the Light to save those trapped by the Darkness! Face down your foes, knowing that you have the power of Light, Might, and Right on your side!

8692.Name: J5
8692.Description: The next evolution in Bounty Hunting wear!

8736.Name: Tower of Necromancy
8736.Description: Your very own Tower of Necromancy!

8908.Name: Phloyd
8908.Description: I think there's something funny in this Moglin.

8912.Name: Accessory DaiDoji Katana
8912.Description: This blade once belonged to the weapon collection of one of Akiba's finest samurai. It is color custom to your armor's ACCESSORY color.

8913.Name: Accessory DaiDoji Dual Katanas
8913.Description: These blades once belonged to the weapon collection of one of Akiba's finest samurai. They are color custom to your armor's ACCESSORY color.

8914.Name: Three Worlds Scythe
8914.Description: This scythe was the result of three different cultures coming together. Elves, Dwarves and Mukluks each contributes materials and methods do its creation.

8940.Name: Treasure Chest
8940.Description: You have found a Treasure Chest! To open it you must get a Magic Treasure Chest Key from TWILLY or VALENCIA in Battleon! Type /join Battleon and speak to one of them. Inside you will find an epic item that you can't find anywhere else or other great rewards!

8950.Name: Hyper Suit of Dark
8950.Description: Less bulky, and crafted for agility, this suit enhances your strength to ensure your enemies will never see you before they are eliminated.

8951.Name: Density Armor of Light
8951.Description: Your prey cannot use the darkness to hide it if you become a beacon of light!

8952.Name: Density Armor of Dark
8952.Description: Use darkness to your utmost advantage in this armor. Hunt before you can be hunted.

8953.Name: Hunter Helm of Light
8953.Description: Embrace the light in this helm.

8954.Name: Hunter Helm of Dark
8954.Description: Become one with the darkness in this cowl.

8955.Name: Lost Blade of Thagnul
8955.Description: This blade was thought to be lost in the fliery depths of a mountain's heart.

8957.Name: Highland Savage Armet
8957.Description: This conqueror's helmet will protect you from invader's arrows and the thickest of iron swords.

8959.Name: Decay
8959.Description: The origin of this sword is unknown, but legend says the smithing required a sacrificial element...

8961.Name: Twin Drake Cutters
8961.Description: Caution: These enchanted blades may bite YOU as well as your enemy...

8962.Name: Dual Power Saws
8962.Description: I'm twice the lumberjack and double the OK...

8963.Name: Sanctified Glaives
8963.Description: These celestial glaives glow with a sacred brilliance.

8964.Name: Azure Flaming Fists
8964.Description: You passion to fight burns hot within your heart...and your fists! Ahhhh! Stop drop and roll! STOP DROP AND ROLL!!

8965.Name: Grotesque Bow
8965.Description: This bow wriggles and writhes with dark energies.

9004.Name: Gilded Fallen Angel
9004.Description: This armor is reserved for disgraced warriors who were exiled from the sky kingdoms.

9009.Name: Zealith Reaver Helm
9009.Description: Become the Darknesssss... Join usss... Be consumed by the Darknesssss...

9012.Name: Valor Domed Helm
9012.Description: Charge into battle with this gilded helmet of the heavens!

9014.Name: Lotus Helm
9014.Description: Don't be too distracted by the chic hairstyle, the elegant silver kanzashi can slice off fingers if they need to.

9019.Name: Gilded Fallen Angel Wings
9019.Description: Disgraced warriors are stripped of their wings, so they must manufacture their own.

9020.Name: Backblades of Assassins
9020.Description: All assassins could use extra knives in an easy to reach cape! Thus goes the motto of Lord SlayR.

9021.Name: Sanctified Sword and Shield
9021.Description: The sword glows with a sacred brilliance, and the shield protects you with it's power.

9072.Name: Shadow Pirate
9072.Description: This pirate has risen from t' depths, hauntin' t' shadows, waitin' t' steal t' most prized o' ships.

9131.Name: Le Chocolat
9131.Description: This legendary chocolate coin can only be obtained through hard work and careful trading. Wear it proudly, you are now poor.

9161.Name: Oni's Visage
9161.Description: As an Oni, you possess extraordinary strength and cat-like reflexes. Unfortunately, you won't be very popular with the locals.

9170.Name: Turtle Shell
9170.Description: Your tough shell will protect you in the heat of combat, assuming you are quick enough to get there in the first place.

9171.Name: Turtle Marauder Head
9171.Description: Let's just hope you aren't snapping at your friends with this on.

9198.Name: Crimson Helm
9198.Description: We who are about to respawn, /salute you!

9275.Name: SkyPirate Annhilator Recognition
9275.Description: Sell this token of the SkyGuard's appreciation to reap your golden reward for annihilating all those SkyPirates!

9395.Name: Super-Fan Swag Token C
9395.Description: Give this to Malorie to turn in for Wyld Dragyns gear!

9396.Name: Super-Fan Swag Token D
9396.Description: Give this to Malorie to turn in for Wyld Dragyns gear!

9397.Name: Token of Collection
9397.Description: Only by annihilating the monsters imprisoned along with Will and Fred can you work out your frustration at being trapped in this rare nightmare!

9909.Name: Fishing Dynamite
9909.Description: Directions: Light fuse and toss into pond. Proceed to collect everything that blasts out of the water after you hear the BOOM! (Warning: Do not toss into bath tubs or toilets!)

10045.Name: Blackserker Champion 11
10045.Description: These Berserkers have won countless battles and their thirst for combat is never ending. The mere sight of one of these juggernauts will strike fear into the enemy and in most cases send them running before the battle has begun!

10214.Name: Darkside
10214.Description: Recommended enhancement: Wizard. Vader Darkside wished that the Cheezburger change into a farming based, pet class and thus the Darkside Class was born!

10246.Name: Evolved ClawSuit 11
10246.Description: [Duplicate of Evolved Clawsuit Class] Recommended enhancement: Hybrid. The Evolved Clawsuit is an unexpected (and unwanted) gift to all the naughty beings of the world. You spread more damage than cheer - and are incredibly good at it.

10610.Name: Amethyst Flame Unicorn
10610.Description: Scalding flames of purple lick the air as this baby unicorn charges with you into battle. Feasome, glowing eyes stare into the soul, ripping it to shreds slowly as you cut your enemy down. Paired with this fearsome youngling, you will not be stopped.

10717.Name: Golden Cheezburger Deluxe
10717.Description: This item is no longer used in-game. It was used to merge into the Aussie Opera House in the CheezBurger Trade-In shop, which is rare.

10751.Name: Mini Energy Tornado
10751.Description: Winds of Fury fly in the faces of your foes when you have THIS little guy equipped!

11086.Name: Battle Wyvern
11086.Description: This is a BATTLE PET and will attack for Pet Classes. It takes a strong will to train a Wyvern but it was hardly a challenge for you. Now its razor sharp claws and silent, deadly wings are at your command.

11339.Name: Interfector Deorum
11339.Description: Join forces with Knave1, King Alteon's personal UndeadSlayer, to battle across Lore! Knave1 is the winner of the final I Can Has Mod contest, and YOU kept your Final Cheezburger! Everyone wins!

11340.Name: Dual Golden Spirit Rods
11340.Description: The purest gold radiates a glow worthy of gods. Hold in your hands the gold only a god can handle, the unlimited power that only you can hold in your hands. Use it wisely.

11341.Name: Dual Blood Spirit Staff
11341.Description: Pulsing with the very lifeblood of a fallen hero, these dual-wield staves will bring the hero's spirit to the fight, fortifying you and your allies for the battle ahead. Do not let such a gift go to waste.

11359.Name: Legion Titan
11359.Description: You have chosen your path. There is no going back now. As a Titan, you have sacrificed--nay, invested--your soul to the Undead Legion. Your committed dedication has earned you the right to don this title. Unleash the power of the almighty Legion Titan!

11471.Name: Roc Tongue
11471.Description: This is an alchemy reagent. Visit the Alchemy Academy to combine alchemy ingredients.

11472.Name: Moglin Tears
11472.Description: This is an alchemy reagent. Visit the Alchemy Academy to combine alchemy ingredients.

11475.Name: Dragon Scale
11475.Description: This is an alchemy reagent. Visit the Alchemy Academy to combine alchemy ingredients.

11480.Name: Necrot
11480.Description:
This is an alchemy reagent of significant power. Visit the Alchemy Academy to combine alchemy ingredients.
Can stack up to x30.

11481.Name: Chaoroot
11481.Description: This is an alchemy reagent of significant power. Visit the Alchemy Academy to combine alchemy ingredients.

11608.Name: Aluminum
11608.Description: This huge hunk of metal has been mined from Raw Ore deposits. Aluminum is required for forging an item of "Blinding Light"... so hold on to it!

11620.Name: Power Tonic
11620.Description: Use to increase your strength by 16% for 10 minutes.

11635.Name: Sage Tonic
11635.Description: Use to increase your intelligence by 20% for 15 minutes.

11644.Name: Fortitude Tonic
11644.Description: Use to increase your endurance by 16% for 10 minutes.

11662.Name: Judgment Tonic
11662.Description: Use to increase your wisdom by 10% for 5 minutes.

11741.Name: Potent Battle Elixir
11741.Description: Use to increase your physical damage by 25% for 15 minutes.

11745.Name: Potent Malevolence Elixir
11745.Description: Use to increase your magic damage by 25% for 15 minutes.

11955.Name: Caladbolg
11955.Description: Wielding Caladbolg, you will be able to chop the heads off your enemies and the tops off hills!

11984.Name: Interfector Deorum Helm
11984.Description: This helm shines with the light of the just, the true, and the defenders of Lore!

12184.Name: Spirit Orb
12184.Description: The Undead are not alive, but are not dead, either. The Undead still have a spirit, and that spirit is trapped within the Spirit Orb. If you can gather enough Spirit Orbs, then you might be able to forge an item of "Blinding Light."

12185.Name: Dark Spirit Orb
12185.Description: Creatures from the Plane of Darkness cannot exist in our world. However, Dark Spirit Orbs offer protection against the Light, allowing the Shadows to curse anything they touch. If one collects enough Dark Spirit Orbs, then they too will be consumed by the shadows... and in return shall harness unspeakable power...

12290.Name: Indigo Paladin
12290.Description: "By land or sea, I will protect thee."

12297.Name: Copper
12297.Description: This huge hunk of metal has been mined from Raw Ore deposits. Copper is required for forging an item of "Blinding Light"... so hold on to it!

12311.Name: Loyal Spirit Orb
12311.Description: Even after you have freed the Undead Spirits trapped within the Spirit Orbs, this Loyal Spirit Orb wishes to stay with you! If you can gather enough Loyal Spirit Orbs, you might be able to forge an item of "Blinding Light."

12408.Name: Sanctified Silver
12408.Description: This piece of metal has been blessed with a divine enchantment. Sanctified Silver is required for forging an item of "Blinding Light"... so hold on to it!

12442.Name: Heroic ZombieSlayer Armor
12442.Description: The undead walk the land, slain and reborn by Sepulchure's toxic fog. It is up to you to save the innocent, rescue the weak, and slay those who would tear down the home you have defended so valiantly. You are the Zombie Killer!

12444.Name: Dark Runic Claymore
12444.Description: The script running down the length of this blade pulses with dark energy.

12451.Name: Shadow ZombieSlayer Armor
12451.Description: As a member of the Shadow ZombieSlayer, you are not in it for the protection of humanity. You are fighting just to taste the first ounce of blood.

12452.Name: Shadow ZombieSlayer Sword
12452.Description: With this sword in hand, the walking dead finally have something to fear!

12652.Name: Ultimate Weapon Kit
12652.Description: Battle tested, Paladin approved! This is the only kit on the market that makes Tier 3 Blinding Light of Destiny weapons. Fully loaded with all the tools needed to craft swords, daggers, maces, scythes, and more of "Blinding Light" status.

12704.Name: Blinding Light Fragments
12704.Description: A piece of Artix's Blinding Light of Destiny!

12813.Name: Shurpu Blaze Token
12813.Description: Use these tokens to earn the Pyromancer Class and other pyromantic items from Warlic in the Shurpu Library.

12827.Name: Emblazoned Mask
12827.Description: This mask is crafted in the shape of flame then enchanted to resist fire, filter ash and smoke and glow as if it were true fire. It was the color worn by the ancient Shurpu Masters of Flame.

12917.Name: Scroll of Enrage
12917.Description: This spell forces your target to focus their attacks on you and causes them to attack recklessly lowering their damage for 10 seconds. (Taunt effects do not work on players.)

12994.Name: Legion Blade
12994.Description: Why would you give things to other people?

12997.Name: Dessicated Heart
12997.Description: Why would you give things to other people?

13150.Name: Sword of Sponsors
13150.Description: Your eye for design and product placement is on par with your blade skills.

13286.Name: Zealous Ink
13286.Description: Used to craft spell scrolls at the Dragonrune Hall. Allows crafting of: Blinding Light, Guardian Blast, Shadow Blade, Furious Gale, Enrage and Decay scrolls.

13348.Name: Abyssal Lightning Orbs of Nulgath
13348.Description: (Color Custom Lighting Bolts ) Only true masters of the elements can cast lightning from their hands. Luckily, Nulgath has gifted some of his most faithful followers with this gift!

13354.Name: Azure SpitFire
13354.Description: The Azure SpitFire mercenaries, unlike the Crimson SpitFire mercenaries use cunning skills and deception to beat out their brethren in a long standing contest that dates back to times long forgotten. Only the bounties given out by the Deathshead Destroyers will decide which can will reign supreme.

13357.Name: Azure SpitFire Helm
13357.Description: Donned by members of the SpitFire, this helm represents their allegiances to the Azure clan.

13440.Name: Power Gem
13440.Description: A special (and shiny!) gem awarded to you for reading the weekly AQW newsletter. Once you have earned enough Power Gems, you can buy epic items from Valencia's Power Gem Shop in Battleon. Be sure to check the AQW email every week to earn another free Power Gem!

13486.Name: Classic Defender
13486.Description: Recommended enhancement: Fighter. As renowned protectors of alternate universes, Defenders understand the sacrifices one must make during combat. Defenders will see to it that what they start always ends in victory.

13505.Name: Chaos Gem
13505.Description: This creature will never Chaorrupt again!

14467.Name: Blinding Light of Destiny
14467.Description: You've battled many monsters and saved Lore countless times! The Blinding Light of Destiny may only be wielded by the strongest, most tenacious of Heroes. Artix has no doubt that you have earned this honor!

14468.Name: Blinding Bow of Destiny
14468.Description: Your path of virtue is now complete! Only the virtuous ones are able to wield this bow.

14470.Name: Blinding Mace of Destiny
14470.Description: With the use of this mace, your foes have bent down on one knee, embracing truth and justice!

14473.Name: Blinding Blade of Destiny
14473.Description: Stop the bloodshed! No longer will the people cower from the evil that has plagued the land!

14474.Name: Sepulchure's DoomKnight Armor
14474.Description: Even in death... Sepulchure's harrowing legacy lives on forever. You have proven yourself more terrifying and dedicated than Sepulchure himself. Now you shall do Sepulchure's bidding as Lore's most terrifying DoomKnight!

14475.Name: Necrotic Bow of the Shadow
14475.Description: Honor, you gain honor by killing those who already have earned it. Respect, you earn respect by killing all of those who have gained honor and only then will you become the most feared in the land!

14476.Name: Necrotic Daggers of Destruction
14476.Description: The empire has fallen to the edge of your daggers! They shall bow to you as your reign of terror has started!

14479.Name: Necrotic Broadsword of Bane
14479.Description: Their screams and cries are like a beautiful Baroque symphony!

14985.Name: Chaotic Hourglass
14985.Description: A gift from Sora to Hoshi, this Glowing Hourglass has been chaorrupted. It SHOULD let you see how much time is left in a person's life. How, though...?

15594.Name: DragonLord Prime
15594.Description: Dragonlords are elite warriors who have a strong spiritual bond with their dragon allies. When facing a Dragonlord, you'd better be skilled at dragonslaying too. Unlocked by purchasing a Dragon Amulet package in DragonFable.

15637.Name: Pristine Blades of Order
15637.Description: The Blades of Order have guarded the Amberheart Tower for millennia, watching and waiting to protect the Land from any foul creatures....till now. When off duty, the order must still remain on high alert.

15651.Name: Healer
15651.Description: Recommended enhancement: Healer. Healers are servants of good who use their powers to aid the sick, weak, and injured. Their powerful healing magic is often the difference between a group's victory or doom.

15652.Name: Rogue
15652.Description: Recommended enhancement: Thief. Rogues follow their own set of rules. With a combination of speed, cunning and poisons, you take your enemies by surprise.

15653.Name: Mage
15653.Description: Recommended enhancement: Wizard. Magic courses through your veins. Your arcane powers enable you to cast powerful spells.

15654.Name: Warrior
15654.Description: Recommended enhancement: Fighter. The heart of a warrior is filled with courage and strength. Your skills with weapons in close combat make you a powerful force on the battlefield.

15733.Name: Helm of the Grid
15733.Description: You shall protect all of those in cyberspace and beyond!

15796.Name: DragonLord Blade Prime
15796.Description: A blade fit for pealing the scales off of a dragon. Tonight, we dine in Lore!

15974.Name: Mystic Parchment
15974.Description: Exchange this mystic parchement with Neveya, in Dragonrune Hall, for magical inks. You can write your own spell scrolls with magical inks.

15975.Name: Mystic Shards
15975.Description: Exchange these mystic shards with Warlic for magical inks. You can write your own spell scrolls with magical inks.

16048.Name: Emerald Pickaxe
16048.Description: Relics from a lost society, these pickaxes belonged to the Emerald Elven Clan who use to dwell in the forest before it was corrupted by Chaos. Now all that is left from this great race are these legendary weapons.

16350.Name: XP Boost! (1 hr)
16350.Description: Thank you for supporting AQWorlds and Artix Entertainment! You're OUR Hero! Using this item will DOUBLE all experience gained from killing monsters or completing quests for 1 hour of in-game play time.

16407.Name: SoulForge Hammer
16407.Description: Wield this massive hammer in Dage's Soul Forge! By using a combination of Obsidian Rocks and Solidified Souls, you too can create Undead Legion items.

16409.Name: Obsidian Rock
16409.Description: A large hunk of Obsidian Rock, used in Dage's Soul Forge in the Underworld.

16700.Name: Golden Dragon Blade 13
16700.Description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And then we gilded it so it would shine even brighter on Galanoth's birthday!

16743.Name: Treasure Vault Key
16743.Description: Chaos Lord Lionfang's Chaos Manticore has guarding the key to Lionfang's treasure vault. You must possess this key to open the vault and the treasure chest inside.

16952.Name: Evolved Dragon Blade
16952.Description: This weapon was made for hunting the most fearsome beasts of Lore! And we aren't talking about Sneevils or Zards here... take on Dragons with your Evolved Dragon Blade!

17137.Name: LightCaster
17137.Description: The Order of the LightCasters formed to support the Champion of Light, and need every mage available to fight the battle against Chaos!

17178.Name: Legendary Hero
17178.Description: Recommended enhancement: Fighter. You are truly one of Lore's greatest heroes! Because of your support and efforts in battle, the world will be saved!

17436.Name: XP Boost! (1 hr)
17436.Description: Using this item will DOUBLE all experience gained from killing monsters or completing quests for 1 hour of in-game play time. Does not expire while logged out.

17585.Name: Blade of Awe
17585.Description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

18150.Name: Jouster
18150.Description: Crash into battle on your clockwork steed! Find the quest to unlock MechaJouster Class in /airstorm!

18478.Name: CLASS Boost! (1 hr)
18478.Description: Using this item will DOUBLE all class rank points gained from killing monsters or completing quests for 1 hour of in-game play time. Does not expire while logged out.

18520.Name: Legend Armor
18520.Description: You are truly one of Lore's greatest heroes! Because of your support and efforts in battle, the world will be saved!

18706.Description: [Duplicate of Legendary Hero Class] Recommended enhancement: Fighter. You are truly one of Lore's greatest heroes! Because of your support and efforts in battle, the world will be saved!

18707.Description: You are truly one of Lore's greatest heroes! Because of your support and efforts in battle, the world will be saved!

18710.Name: Dark Legend Sword
18710.Description: You are truly one of Lore's greatest heroes! Because of your support and efforts in battle, the world will be saved!

18711.Name: Fiend Orb
18711.Description: The Fiend is always watching you. This orb connects directly to him. Be VERY careful what you do and say.

18804.Name: Underworld Dagger of Courage
18804.Description: The Underworlds denizens number many. Some unnamed blacksmith's soul made these daggers. Only those of courageous hearts can wield them, and impose their will to color the weapon.

18806.Name: Underworld Hammer of Judgement
18806.Description: This hammer can only be used and colored by those who are completely unbiased. The best judges are always neutral.

18807.Name: Underworld Hammer
18807.Description: This hammer can only be used by those who are completely unbiased. The best judges are always neutral.

18808.Name: Underworld Sword of Loyalty
18808.Description: Warriors of a loyal disposition are the only people who can uses these swords. If their loyalty is strong enough, it will manifest itself as a unique color along the blade.

18920.Name: Doom Wyrm Wings +5
18920.Description: Gives +5% boost to reputation earned and +3% boost to gold drops.

18924.Name: Doom Wings of Ishtar
18924.Description: Majestic multi-colored wings sprout from your back. Take flight as an avatar of war and bring defeat and shame to your enemies.

18927.Name: Treasure Potion
18927.Description:
Collect enough of these and you may be granted a very DOOM-y wish! https://www.aq.com/lore/guides/WheelOfDoomFAQ
CANNOT BE BANKED! Cannot be consumed! This is not a bug!

19014.Name: Begemmed Blade
19014.Description: Entrance your opponents with the gleaming gems bound into this blade!

19141.Name: Doom Phoenix Blade +5
19141.Description: From the ashes the phoenix will rise. Only the most proven veterans of Lore carry this sword of rebirth.

19144.Name: Chaos Doom Robe
19144.Description: The robes that once clothed a Chaos Mage now belong to you! Chaos makes you look slimming.

19146.Name: Doom Lycan Armor
19146.Description: Charroupted creatures don't have fleas, right? Let's hope not... because Aria's pet shop is all out of flea collars!

19147.Name: Doom Lycan Wings
19147.Description: A pair of giant wings plucked off a Chaos creature! He won't be needing these anymore...

19155.Name: Desoloth's Doom
19155.Description: Desoloth the Final is dead... or is he? Do not underestimate this prime example of the elements' power. Be wary, for you do not know what legacy Desoloth has left in his place.

19156.Name: Doom Trislayer
19156.Description: This armor shows that you have slain Trigoras, the great three-headed dragon!

19157.Name: Doom Trislayer Helm
19157.Description: On the sides of this helm are the claw tips of the great dragon Trigoras himself.

19158.Name: Trislayer Blade of Doom +5
19158.Description: This blade is carved painstakingly from one of Trigoras' claws, formed a brutal, jagged edge able to cut through most anything with ease. It does 15% MORE damage against Dragons!

19160.Name: Doom Rook
19160.Description: Rooks take many forms in this ancient game. Sometimes they were depicted as berserkers. Sometimes, castles. But whatever they're incarnation, they are meant to seem unstoppable.

19165.Name: Doom Karma Army
19165.Description: Free will is just an illusion, because once you cross paths with the Karma Army, choosing to live with be out of your hands. Hope those "good deeds" that you have been performing finally pays off for you.

19167.Name: Doom Realm Guardian Helm
19167.Description: You have defended the area outside Swordhaven valiantly! King Alteon the Good thanks you, and wishes to reward you with this helm.

19169.Name: Doom Courage Moglin
19169.Description:
CLIMB THE TALLEST MOUNTAIN
PUNCH THE SKY IN THE FACE

19172.Name: Yellow Doom Moglin
19172.Description: I think this young moglin has taken a liking to you.

19189.Name: Daily XP Boost! (1 hr)
19189.Description: Using this item will DOUBLE all experience gained from killing monsters or completing quests for 1 hour of in-game play time. Does not expire while logged out.

19199.Name: Doom Zealith Reavers
19199.Description: Did... SWAGGY borrow Dage's Zealith Reavers for the Wheel? And who painted them red?! That... that IS paint, right? So many questions!

19200.Name: Zealith Doom Reaver
19200.Description: Did... SWAGGY borrow Dage's Zealith Reavers for the Wheel? What happened to the other one? And who painted it red?! That... that IS paint, right? So many questions!

19250.Name: Doom Celestial Sandhelm
19250.Description: The SandStone Guard are an elite corps of SandKnights. This helm, with its long, flowing crest, makes it easy to identify these superior warriors.

19315.Name: Doom Madness of Chaos
19315.Description: You cannot bring order out of Chaos. Chaos is complete insanity. And that madness has taken you over.

19316.Name: Doom Lilith Katana +5
19316.Description: A mystic katana from the para-elemental plane teeming with incalculable amounts of raw magic. Does more damage against DRAGONS!!!

19323.Name: Doom Dragon Blade
19323.Description: A "gift" given to a Red Dragon from a former Dragonslayer. How kind of him to pass the present along to you!

19324.Name: Doom Dragon Club
19324.Description: An elegantly chaotic club, sculpted to resemble a dragon and consequently is as powerful as one. No longer will your battles drag-on!

19326.Name: DOOMing Fork
19326.Description: A useful polearm that is used for tuning instruments, slaying monsters, and skewering large chunks of Gorillaphant meat. Move aside, spork!

19327.Name: Doom Brothers Hat
19327.Description: You've got the Soul, Man, and this stylish fedora/sunglasses combo proves it!

19392.Name: Alpha DOOMmega
19392.Description: [Duplicate of Alpha Omega Class] Recommended enhancement: Fighter. Be the beginning AND the end of ALL your battles in Alpha Omega Class!

19403.Name: Polearm of the Forsaken
19403.Description: An elite cadre of sentient undead known as The Forsaken wield these weapons. Their front line is composed of polearm wielders, who's chops are so powerful that they can split shields down the middle.

19406.Name: Sceptre of Divination
19406.Description: Beware the gypsy powers infused in this staff, for they're guaranteed to blow your mind (anytime!).

19410.Name: Gargantuan Golem Morph
19410.Description: They say the eyes are the windows to the soul. Does this golem have a soul?

19412.Name: Alchemist's Dual Repeaters
19412.Description: Equipped with a magically enhanced scope, damage potion, magic wand and razor sharp bayonet. Its like a Swiss army knife for crazed magicians.

19541.Name: Tousled Archangel Hair
19541.Description: Even angels need to update their hairstyle! Aranx has perfected the archangel hairdo.

20561.Name: Dragon Shinobi Token
20561.Description: Use these tokens to earn the Dragon Shinobi Class variants and other set items.

20662.Name: Oracle
20662.Description: Recommended enhancement: Spellbreaker. Oracles are strong healers and can see into everyone's future, past and present! They can notify their friends of their opponents weaknesses and strengths!

20670.Name: Chaos Lord Alteon
20670.Description: After you defeat a chaos lord, there's no reason not to steal their clothes.

20674.Name: Boreas Staff
20674.Description: For a weapon made entirely of clouds and air, this thing hits pretty hard.

20678.Name: Blade Of The Mount
20678.Description: Fun fact: the whorls in the center of the blade are created when the metal is infused with magical energy.

20707.Name: Royal Broadsword
20707.Description: A beautiful reminder of your loyalty to a fallen city.

20711.Name: Nobles Mace
20711.Description: Combines the shiny gold a noble craves with the sharp edges a warrior needs!

20713.Name: Nobles Cinquedea
20713.Description: They may look ornamental, but these daggers are solid and deadly.

20714.Name: Frozen Fire Staff
20714.Description: Is it ice? Is it fire? It's the best of both worlds!

20771.Name: Shriekward Potion
20771.Description: Drink to prevent the effect of the Chaos Harpy's powerful shriek. Does not work if you're already under its effect.

20879.Name: Shadow DoomReaver
20879.Description: The shadows wear away at your soul... and your sanity!

20914.Name: Tuxedo Daimyo
20914.Description: Ever by his side, Artix's loyal Battle Puppy escorted him down the aisle.

21116.Name: Giant Hungry Werewolf
21116.Description: This Werewolf pet is HUNGRY for TURKEY -- I mean Turdraken!

21154.Name: Black Sonic Blade
21154.Description: When a youngling first becomes a time traveler's apprentice, they must make their own first sonic. The color of the blade is determined by the gem they use.

21172.Name: Memet Got Your Hat
21172.Description: What do you MEAN your hat isn't my birthday present, Zazul?

21338.Name: Sub-Zero Axe 13
21338.Description: Introduce your enemies to the big chill known as their icy graves!

21523.Name: IceRender
21523.Description: The legendary blade of the rulers of the Northlands should only be drawn when the world has ended... and one must break through the ice to a new dawn!

21524.Name: Royal Frost Helm
21524.Description: The rulers of the Northland depend on their leaders to see with clear vision and foresight... and for that, you must not shield your face!

21525.Name: Royal Frost Faceguard
21525.Description: Protect yourself at all costs because the fate of the Northlands depends on you!

21527.Name: Sheathed Icerender
21527.Description: Brotherblade to the Iceheart, the Icerender may only be drawn when the world has ended... and one must break through the ice to a new dawn!

21528.Name: Iceheart
21528.Description: The legendary blade of the rulers of the Northlands. Wield this well, Your Majesty!

21529.Name: Battle Frost King and Queen
21529.Description: Only the most worthy of royalty can tame the frigid northlands!

21555.Name: Ringbearer Daimyo Battlepet
21555.Description: Of course the Battle Daimyo Ringbearer would use the wedding ring's diamond as a laser! ... You cannot fire diamond lasers from a pillow, after all!

21750.Name: Dual Legion Doombringer
21750.Description: The weapon of choice for wrecking the halls.

22208.Name: Hebi Twintana
22208.Description: You are awesome. And you deserve a weapon that's equally as awesome. That's why we're giving this item to anyone who supported AQW in the last 6 months!

22245.Name: Mini-Nulgath Battle Pet
22245.Description:
CLIMB THE TALLEST MOUNTAIN
PUNCH THE SKY IN THE FACE
FOUND IN THE FORTUNE MERGE SHOP

22332.Name: Blood Gem of the Archfiend
22332.Description: Little is known about these gems from the ArchFiend himself. This gem feels warm to the touch and sometimes if you stare long enough, it will begin to pulse hypnotically. One of the ArchFiend's most valuable gemstones.

22447.Name: Daily Login Class Boost  (20 min)
22447.Description: Using this item will DOUBLE all class rank points gained from killing monsters or completing quests for 20 minutes of in-game play time. Does not expire while logged out.

22448.Name: Daily Login XP Boost! (20 min)
22448.Description: Using this item will DOUBLE all experience gained from killing monsters or completing quests for 20 minutes of in-game play time. Does not expire while logged out.

22449.Name: Daily Login Rep Boost! (20 min)
22449.Description: Using this item will DOUBLE all reputation gained from completing quests and all other sources for 20 minutes of in-game play time. Does not expire while logged out.

22450.Name: Daily Login Gold Boost! (20 min)
22450.Description: Using this item will DOUBLE all Gold gained from killing monsters or completing quests for 20 minutes of in-game play time. Does not expire while logged out.

22923.Name: Alliance Elite
22923.Description: This armor is reserved for the most elite soldiers in the Alliance. Chaos doesn't stand a chance when these heavily armored champions enter the field.

23289.Name: Undead Death Guard
23289.Description: Those who wish to pay their respects at the Altar may not always like what they find... when it means they DIE! But the altar ALWAYS needs more guards.

23291.Name: Undead DeathGuard Helm
23291.Description: No man shall look upon the face of an Altar guardian!

24020.Name: Doom Shielded Centurion Armor
24020.Description: The Golden Centurions are soldiers from a fabled sunken city. Thier shields were said to withstand even magical arrows.

24136.Name: Gravelyn's Champion
24136.Description: Loyal to the TRUE ruler and to Shadowfall. Dedicated champions of the Empress and the Shadowscythe. (5% chance to do the Meteor Shower attack animation, 15% XP boost non-stackable)

24137.Name: Gravelyn's Champion Claymore
24137.Description: Crafted by Gravelyn's own weaponsmith, this blade grants it's wielder powers of the Shadowscythe not given to just any follower. Use it well. (5% chance to do the Meteor Shower attack animation, 15% XP boost non-stackable)

24138.Name: Gravelyn's Champion Helm
24138.Description: Strike fear into the hearts of your foes and exclaim LONG UN-LIVE THE SHADOWSCYTHE! (5% chance to do the Meteor Shower attack animation, 15% XP boost non-stackable)

24139.Name: Gravelyn's Champion Cloak
24139.Description: Red and black, the colors of the Shadowscythe. (5% chance to do the Meteor Shower attack animation, 15% XP boost non-stackable)

24379.Name: Blazing Chaos Blade
24379.Description: Raging chaos infused into this blade gives it the glow.

24528.Name: Chaos War Medal
24528.Description: Keep this medal to merge into new gear in the Chaos War merge shop.

24562.Name: Obsidian Assassin
24562.Description: Your targets can't see your obsidian form in the dark, but with those 3 glowing eyes you'll definitely see them.

24563.Name: Obsidian Assassin Helmet
24563.Description: I thought it was just a mask, but man, I swear that third eye just moved!

24564.Name: Legion Obsidian Assassin
24564.Description: Your targets can't see your obsidian form in the dark, but with those 3 glowing eyes you'll definitely see them.

24565.Name: Legion Obsidian Assassin Helmet
24565.Description: I thought it was just a mask, but man, I swear that third eye just moved!

24766.Name: Phoenix
24766.Description: The phoenix will always rise from the ashes, this one most have arisen from golden ashes.

24797.Name: Pinnacle Spear
24797.Description: The mountains can be treacherous, a long-range weapon is the best choice.

24798.Name: Summit Shield Cape
24798.Description: Some have the weight of the mountains on their backs, thankfully you just have this shield.

24800.Name: Mountain Breaker Helm
24800.Description: Full coverage in case of falling rocks.

24802.Name: Chaos Pinnacle Spear
24802.Description: You really only need to jab one rock. The right one will send the whole mountain down.

24803.Name: Chaos Summit Shield Cape
24803.Description: When the landslide happens, just make sure you're under this. Yep, just use it like a turtle shell.

24804.Name: Chaos Mountain Breaker Locks
24804.Description: When you're breaking mountains, you need a good helm. You know, because of the falling boulders.

24805.Name: Chaos Mountain Breaker Helm
24805.Description: When you're breaking mountains, you need a good helm. You know, because of the falling boulders.

24806.Name: Shadow Dragon Morph
24806.Description: Long un-live the Shadowscythe! When Shadowfall rises Dragons shall return and it will be glorious!

24807.Name: Shadow Dragon Morph Head
24807.Description: Who wouldn't want to be a dragon?

24808.Name: Shadow Dragon Morph Wings
24808.Description: These will come in handy if you ever need to fly away from Galanoth.

24837.Name: Doomknight Shadowmage
24837.Description: Brethren to the DoomKnight BattleMages, the ShadowMage dives deeper into the macabre and otherworldly styles of enchanting. (3% chance to do the smokebomb animation, and 5% XP boost non-stackable)

24838.Name: ShadowMage Cape
24838.Description: Cloaked in darkness. (3% chance to do the smokebomb animation, and 5% XP boost)

24839.Name: Golden DoomFlame
24839.Description: Burn, baby, burn. (3% chance to do the smokebomb animation, and 5% XP boost)

24843.Name: Horned ShadowMage Hood
24843.Description: Shadows conceal something sinister. (3% chance to do the smokebomb animation, and 5% XP boost)

24880.Name: Beastmaster Ravager
24880.Description: Originally just a rumor from an old story lost to time, whispers of a destructive beast have begun to spread from village to village. (3% chance to do Shadowburst animation, 5% Class Points Boost)

24881.Name: Beastmaster Ravager Cape
24881.Description: The destruction caused can be seen in the tears of this cape.(3% chance to do Shadowburst animation, 5% Class Points Boost)

24884.Name: Beastmaster Ravager Helm
24884.Description: Ravager's bring devastation and destruction to where ever they go. (3% chance to do Shadowburst animation, 5% Class Points Boost)

24969.Name: Last Stone of Battleon
24969.Description: This stone is a symbol of hope for the people of Lore. It is the last remaining piece of our former town. If you have it in your inventory, the fountain in Northpointe will turn into a miniature replica of the guardian tower. Place the stone in your bank to revert it.

25026.Name: Seal of Light
25026.Description: Save 50 seals and combine with the Seal of Darkness to create Valen's armor!

25027.Name: Seal of Darkness
25027.Description: Save 50 seals and combine with the Seal of Darkness to create Valen's armor!

25282.Name: Original Drakath Armor
25282.Description: Chaos reigns?? HAHAHAHAHAAAA! This armor is PROOF you've taken down the Champion of Chaos!

25286.Name: Drakath's Sword
25286.Description: The legendary sword that has been by Drakath for nearly 6 years. Sooo...chaorrupted.

25447.Name: Ascended Light of Destiny
25447.Description: To reward you for obtaining Drakath's Armor... we're giving you another Blinding Light of Destiny! (With an added 5% Rep bonus!)

25539.Name: Cyber King
25539.Description: Success! You've uploaded your own awareness into virtual reality, now you are reborn in cyberspace. Beware of hackers though.

25540.Name: Cyber Dark Dragon's Rage
25540.Description: Do dragons not scare you, but darkness still mocks you? Wish you had a nightlight to go with you on those long adventures? Why, say hello to THIS... thing.

25548.Name: Bright Amadis
25548.Description: Forged in secret by skilled craftsman, this armor gives off an aura of calmly reflection, keeping the wearer ready for anything. (5% change to do the Whirlwind attack animation, 10% bonus against Dragons)

25549.Name: Shining Amadis Wings
25549.Description: Wings of the Amadis reflect the clear aura of those who serve Good. (5% chance to do the Whirlwind attack animation, 20% bonus against Dragons)

25623.Name: Legendary Naval Commander
25623.Description: [Duplicate of Naval Commander Class] Recommended enhancement: Lucky, Thief. Yarrrr! True Naval commanders know they need to battle with a crew!

25735.Name: Dual Blazing Chaos Blades
25735.Description: Raging chaos infused into these blades giving them their glow.

25779.Name: Drakath Armor
25779.Description: Chaos reigns?? HAHAHAHAHAAAA! This armor is PROOF you've taken down the Champion of Chaos!

26465.Name: Ghost of Mogloween Pet
26465.Description: Just because you're a ghost doesn't mean you can't be fashionable!

26972.Name: Cyber Chaos Blade

75216.Description: Stalking the shadows of the Black Labyrinth, the NightStalker is one of the terrors that waits to prey on those foolish enough to believe they can come out alive.

75602.Description: The infamous Doom Knight, a scourge on life no matter where it sprouts.

75605.Description: The visage of the Empress of the Shadowscythe, the fell star that brings the gods to their knees.

75757.Description: Spend enough time in the service of the Archfiend and you will begin go resemble him. Sometimes the change is immediate, but the Archfiend is patient if you plan to take your time.

76149.Name: Lunarian Astromancer Trainee
76149.Description: An Astromancer training to learn the ways of the Moon. The best way to do that is to get as close to that big hunk of cheese as possible.

76152.Name: Lunarian Trainee Locks
76152.Description: Legends speak of rabbits living on the Moon. Some even say that the Moon is a rabbit! Then best play it safe and dress to appeal to those lunar bunnies. The Astromancers' craft seems to deepen when they're motivated like this.

76163.Name: Lunarian Blasters
76163.Description: This is one of the best weapons available for an Astromancer training to learn the ways of the Moon.

76290.Name: Kitty Kawaii Outfit
76290.Description: For cat fans or people as capricious as a kitten. Yesterday's favorite toy is today's boring torn up ball of fluff, but you can't not love this wardrobe!

76294.Name: Blushing Bandaid Visage
76294.Description: You'll risk it all for your love. As in affection for your pets. A cat scratching your face is expected but call the authorities if a person does that.

76298.Name: Shaded Kitty Bandaids Visage
76298.Description: You'll risk it all for your love. As in affection for your pets. A cat scratching your face is expected but call the authorities if a person does that.

76559.Name: Malgor the ShadowLord
76559.Description: The armor of the Shadowlord, the origin of the Shadowflame that scorched Lore to its core. As for where Malgor himself came from...that is a secret best kept until the world and its creator are ready.

76560.Name: ShadowLord's Helm
76560.Description: The helmet of the Shadowlord, the origin of the Shadowflame that scorched Lore to its core. His visage was formed and forged by an endless chase for an impossible dream.

77137.Name: Malgor's ShadowFlame Blade
77137.Description: Malgor's personal blade, in your hands. You can feel his conviction, sorrow, anger, and desperation engraved into the features of the sword. (This item is CC to Trim,Accessory)

77638.Name: Sunless Saber Hooded Visor
77638.Description: Their affinity for the fourth was so great that it addled the rest of their body, which became an immovable prison in of itself. They resorted to dark masteries to gain powerful bodies and keep their mastery of the fourth.

78397.Name: Hallowed Remains
78397.Description: The remains of an old god. Fetches a high selling price from shops.

78460.Name: Lunarbrand
78460.Description: The breath of a moon deity was torn from its lungs and used to enchant this blade. Somewhere in the Northlands, the moon has lost its face and dignity. You wield the cold night in your hands, released from the curse of needing to sleep.

78465.Name: Solarbrand
78465.Description: The breath of a sun deity was torn from its lungs, and used to temper this blade. Somewhere in the Northlands, the sun is cursed to never rise again, for it is now your constant companion.

78795.Name: Tennousei Retainer Kitsune
78795.Description: An Emperor won the respect of kitsune that sword danced in the heavens. They descended to hear his poems and became his most fiersome and mysterious warriors.

78796.Name: Tennousei Retainer Hood
78796.Description: The Tennousei Retainer Kitsune fiercly guarded an Emperor when he won their respect with his poems. They disappeared into stardust out of shame when the Emperor's successor assassinated him.

78798.Name: Star Dancer's Century Tails
78798.Description: Nine centuries worth of sword dancing experience are gathered in these starry tails. They are a symbol of mastery and loneliness. They will only fulfill their creator's greatest wishes by being gifted to another.

78800.Description: Katanas made from the green flickers of a distant kingly planet, used in sword dances and in combat to protect the wise words of an Emperor.

78806.Name: Sliver of Moonlight

78807.Name: Sliver of Sunlight
78807.Description: A fragment of the sun's power, granted to you by Priestess Himiko.

78808.Description: A benefaction granted by the Entwined Eclipse. Infused is the power of the sun and the moon.

78809.Description: Keep this item in your inventory in order to access the Ascend Eclipse Challenge Dungeon (requires completion of the Temple of the Solstice Moon, Shrine of the Midnight Sun, and the Festival of Victors).

78994.Description: Prevents bad dreams and endless nightmares (does not work if you are already experiencing one).
